segments.spoken_text: This empty cell should not become a zero.
While checking our research workflow, we made a tiny test with three invented rows.
The first has zero saves. The second has no save observation. The third has twelve.
Those first two rows mean different things: observed zero, and information we do not have.
Our local check preserves that difference when it calculates the rate. The missing result stays empty.
This tests one rule. It does not prove the whole report, or explain why a video performed.
A person still reviews which rows can be compared and what evidence is missing.
Open one report you use. Can you tell a measured zero from an unknown?
